name: owncontext
description: A local-first personal context vault for MCP-compatible AI clients.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @owncontext/core && npm run build --workspace @owncontext/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @owncontext/desktop
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:protocol
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @owncontext/core && npm test --workspace @owncontext/core && npm test --workspace @owncontext/mcp-server && npm test --workspace @owncontext/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @owncontext/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @owncontext/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @owncontext/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspace @owncontext/desktop
